name: io.github.JerryLiu369/agent-web-search
title: Agent Web Search
description: Provider-neutral web_search for AI agents. Grounding + agent search APIs, keyless defaults.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated startup-enabled provider set; defaults to ddgs,exa,parallel (all keyless)

environmentVariables.name: ARK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Volcengine Ark API key for Doubao grounding

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key for Google Search grounding

environmentVariables.name: XAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: xAI API key for Grok web/X search

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DeepSeek API key for native web search

environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tavily API key for agent-oriented search

environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Perplexity API key for structured search

environmentVariables.name: EXA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Exa key; free MCP fallback without it

environmentVariables.name: PARALLEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Parallel key; free MCP fallback without it

environmentVariables.name: ZHIPU_WEB_SEARCH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Zhipu standalone Web Search API key

environmentVariables.name: ZHIPU_CHAT_SEARCH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Zhipu Chat Completions native web search key
